question_text: Construct remove_item(self, item) for Shop’s fixed list self.items and occupied count self.used. Assume the exact object item occurs once among occupied entries. Remove it, preserve the relative order of other entries, clear the now-unused position to None, and decrement self.used.
adaptation_rationale: Retains reference-array compaction; tested first, middle, last removal; no Java-specific fixed array syntax.
